postings.title: Program Manager - Long Term Care
postings.description:
Pay Range:

Pay Range:$36.46 - $51.29

Provides high level support to the Long-Term Care Division on multiple projects, liaisons between divisions on behalf of the LTC division and participates in the planning, organization, and execution of operational initiatives. Works collaboratively with each DON and the administrator to ensure services are facilitated to provide maximum opportunity for access to consistent and efficient care.



SEARHC is a non-profit health consortium which serves the health interests of the residents of Southeast Alaska. We see our employees as our strongest assets. It is our priority to further their development and our organization by aiding in their professional advancement.



Working at SEARHC is more than a job, it’s a fulfilling career. We offer generous benefits, including retirement, paid time off, paid parental leave, health insurance, dental, and vision benefits, life insurance and long and short-term disability, and more.









Hours Mon-Fri 8-5

Key Essential Functions and Accountabilities of the Job

Provides administrative support to the LTC Administrator and LTC Team.

Subject matter expert on the LTC EHR.

Works to implement strategies on new and/or changing initiatives and projects. Coordinates projects in respect to resources, equipment, meetings, and information.

Establish and maintain relationships with family members to assist with the admission, reassessments, and data collection for all aspects of resident care documentation and ensure that documents are signed and in chart timely.

Investigations: Key member in investigations; adverse event reports, employee injury reports and complaints.

Performs root cause analysis and recommends corrective action plans. Prepares necessary and/or required reports according to department guidelines.

Manages system for orientation and onboarding of employees. Participate in the development, implementation and maintenance of training modules, documents, materials, and training timelines.

Oversight of supplies maintenance and volumes tracking, within budget.

Function as a member of the Care Coordination team which may include assisting residents with documentation and forms including but not limited to, applications to various services/agencies, Medicaid applications, entitlement programs, eligibility issues, advance directives, power or attorney and guardianships.

Coordinates and submits all state documentation required for LTC authorizations and re-authorizations.

Oversight of submitting/scanning medical records into the electronic record system.

Member of multidisciplinary team and its functions.

Maintains confidentiality regarding administrative and resident issues. Able to demonstrate tact, patience, and reliability in support of resident care.

Oversight of resident medical appointments and schedule per regulatory guidelines. Communicates effectively with healthcare providers and care team.

Coordination of staff scheduling and call schedule.

Responsible for chart audits for compliance. Conducts regulatory and policy review and updates in coordination with DON and Administrator.

Monitors and investigates data for performance trends and reports findings to the team and identifies areas for improvement.



Other Functions

Will be a backup driver for the resident van.



Supervisory Responsibilities

N/A



Education, Certifications, and Licenses RequiredBachelor’s degree in business administration, nursing, or a health-related field

4-6 years of relevant healthcare experience may be exchanged for a degree

Basic Life Support (BLS) certification within 6 months of hire and biannually thereafter.

Certified Professional in Healthcare Quality (CPHQ) obtained within a year.

Driver’s license



Experience Required

3-5 years of office experience with administrative and project oversight in a healthcare facility

Or at least 2 years of demonstrated progressive, relevant experience that includes project coordination, development, and/or management.



Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:



Knowledge of:

General office procedures.

Quality improvement activities.

Facility staffing and scheduling.

Advanced word processing and spreadsheet applications.

Creative mechanisms for the dissemination of information and receipt of customer feedback.



Skills in:

Strong, clear, and strategic communications to diverse audiences – both written and verbal.

Strong presentation skills.

Working cooperatively with various disciplines, staff, providers, and administration.

Proficiently navigating and understanding various medical electronic health records.

Prioritization and judgment and excellent attention to detail.

Energy and enthusiasm.

Ability to multi-task.



Ability to:

Adapt to consistently changing healthcare environments and organizational demands.

Assist in leading CMS survey teams and processes.

Enter and retrieve resident data accurately.

Verbally communicate finding with healthcare team.

Competently maintain a clean work environment with proper infection control measures including equipment cleaning.

Work cooperatively with others by establishing and maintaining interpersonal relationships with residents, visitors, and other healthcare team members.

Ensure confidentiality of resident information.



Computer Skills:

Highly proficient in Microsoft Office Products including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint



Travel Required:

Must be able to travel 10% of the time.



Safety and Risk Management Responsibilities:

Employees are responsible for complying with safe work rules; reporting all accidents and injuries immediately; cooperating in all accident and injury investigations; reporting defective equipment and unsafe conditions.



Physical Demands:

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee is frequently required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to finger, handle or feel and reach with hands and arms.

The employee is occasionally required to climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl. The employee must lift and/or move 50 lbs.



Work Environment:

· The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.



Required Certifications:



Basic Life Support (BLS) - American Heart Association, Certified Professional in Healthcare Quality - National Association for Healthcare Quality, Driver License - State of Alaska



If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

About the Job

   The Lifetime Value Co. is looking for a Data Analyst Contractor (Content Team Support for Data Studies) to join our growing team.

   Are you passionate about uncovering actionable insights from data? Join our forward-thinking content team as a Remote Data Analyst, leveraging your analytical expertise to create compelling data-driven studies that power brand content. You'll play a pivotal role in shaping stories, finding trends, and making sense of complex data sets—using both manual and AI-driven analysis. If you love investigating data from every angle, thrive in a collaborative, creative environment, and have a keen interest in brand storytelling, this is the role for you!

   At LTV, we all work closely together across teams so there's no red tape or bureaucracy. We get things done!

What You Will Get to Do


 
  Data Analysis & Insight Generation: Analyze diverse datasets to identify trends, patterns, and unique angles for content studies. Interpret data using a range of techniques and parameters to meet the content team’s needs.  Great care starts with great people. (Like you.) 


 


 At HonorHealth, you’ll find something special. From humble beginnings in 1927 to one of Arizona’s largest nonprofit healthcare systems, our culture is built on warmth and neighborly kindness. Behind every smile is a highly skilled professional with deep expertise and an unwavering dedication to what matters most — caring for the health and well-being of people and communities across the greater Phoenix area.


 


 Responsibilities:



 
  JOB SUMMARY
 
 

 

 
  The Translational Research Scientist – Synthetic Chemistry will be responsible for guiding all aspects of chemistry, from compound design and optimization to synthesis, as well as managing relationships with external chemistry vendors. This individual will ensure that high-quality, efficient chemistry is executed in alignment with project goals, timelines, and budgetary constraints. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in medicinal chemistry or synthetic organic chemistry, with extensive experience managing external partnerships in drug discovery and development.
 
 

 

 
  ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
 
 
  
   Lead and oversee all chemistry-related efforts, with a focus on managing outsourced chemistry work conducted by external vendors, including CROs. Define the chemistry strategy for discovery and development projects, ensuring alignment with therapeutic goals and timelines. Collaborate with external vendors to design and optimize synthetic routes, manage compound libraries, and ensure the timely delivery of high-quality compounds. Maintain relationships with CROs and other external partners, including negotiating contracts, defining project scopes, timelines, and budgets, and ensuring adherence to contractual obligations. Collaborate closely with internal biology, pharmacology, and preclinical development teams to ensure that chemistry efforts are aligned with broader program goals. Ensure compliance with all regulatory, safety, and quality standards in chemistry-related activities, both internally and at external vendors. Represent the chemistry function in internal and external meetings.
   Provide technical oversight and direction for medicinal chemistry, process chemistry, and compound synthesis, ensuring that chemistry deliverables meet scientific and quality standards.

   EXPERIENCE
  
  
   
    10 years in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, including extensive experience in drug discovery and development. Required

   
  
  

  
   LICENSE AND CERTIFICATIONS
  
 
 

 


 We're all in for your career.

postings.title: Remote Patient Monitoring Product Manager – San Diego, CA
postings.description:
Remote Patient Monitoring Product Manager – San Diego, CA
Are you passionate about transforming healthcare through technology and innovation? We are seeking a Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM) Product Manager to join a forward-thinking healthcare solutions provider in San Diego, CA. In this pivotal role, you will drive the strategy, development, and execution of cutting-edge RPM products designed to improve patient outcomes and provider efficiency. If you thrive in a collaborative, mission-driven environment and have a strong background in digital health products, we want to hear from you.



Drive Innovation in Digital Health from San Diego
A leading healthcare technology company based in San Diego, CA is on the hunt for an experienced Product Manager to lead the growth and evolution of its Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM) platform. The ideal candidate will bring a mix of product vision, technical understanding, and healthcare industry expertise. You will play a central role in identifying market opportunities, working cross-functionally with engineering and clinical teams, and ensuring that product offerings align with both patient needs and business goals. If you're ready to shape the future of RPM solutions, this is your opportunity to lead the charge.



Key Responsibilities of the Remote Patient Monitoring Product Manager – San Diego, CA
Product Strategy & Roadmap Development:
Define and execute the strategic vision for Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM) products, aligning with market trends, regulatory guidelines, and user needs. Develop a clear product roadmap and prioritize features based on business impact, technical feasibility, and user value.


Cross-Functional Collaboration:
Work closely with engineering, design, clinical, and marketing teams to ensure seamless product development and delivery. Act as a bridge between technical and non-technical stakeholders to ensure alignment on goals, timelines, and deliverables.


Market & Competitive Analysis:
Conduct comprehensive research to understand patient, provider, and payer needs. Monitor market trends, competitor products, and emerging technologies to inform product decisions and maintain a competitive edge in the RPM space.


User Experience & Clinical Impact:
Champion the voice of the patient and clinician in the product development lifecycle. Gather user feedback through interviews, surveys, and usability testing to refine features and improve the user experience while driving measurable clinical outcomes.


Product Lifecycle Management:
Oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of RPM solutions—from ideation and development to launch and iteration. Ensure products meet clinical, technical, and regulatory standards throughout each stage of development.


Regulatory & Compliance Alignment:
Collaborate with legal, compliance, and regulatory teams to ensure all RPM products adhere to healthcare regulations such as HIPAA, FDA guidelines, and other relevant frameworks. Proactively identify and mitigate compliance risks.


KPI Tracking & Product Performance:
Establish and monitor product performance metrics, including user adoption, engagement, retention, and clinical efficacy. Use data analytics to evaluate outcomes and guide product enhancements and decision-making.


Stakeholder Engagement & Communication:
Maintain clear and consistent communication with internal stakeholders, executives, and external partners. Provide regular updates on product progress, launch plans, and market feedback to ensure transparency and alignment.


Innovation & Continuous Improvement:
Drive continuous improvement by identifying and implementing new technologies, integrations, or processes that enhance RPM capabilities and outcomes. Stay ahead of digital health innovation to keep products at the forefront of the industry.


Customer Training & Support Enablement:
Support go-to-market teams by creating product documentation, training materials, and support resources. Ensure that providers and care teams understand and effectively utilize RPM solutions for optimal patient care.



What the Client is Looking for in You
As the Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM) Product Manager, the client is seeking a forward-thinking, product-driven leader with a passion for healthcare innovation. You should have a strong background in digital health, excellent product management skills, and the ability to balance user needs with business objectives. The ideal candidate is a collaborative, results-oriented individual who thrives in a fast-paced environment and can deliver scalable healthcare solutions.



Experience in Healthcare Technology and RPM
The client is looking for a Product Manager with hands-on experience in healthcare technology—specifically in Remote Patient Monitoring or related digital health platforms. You should have a proven track record of leading successful product initiatives in regulated environments and a deep understanding of clinical workflows, patient engagement tools, and healthcare interoperability.



Strategic Product Visionary
You must be able to shape and communicate a clear product vision rooted in market needs, user feedback, and industry trends. The ideal candidate has experience creating and executing roadmaps, prioritizing features that deliver maximum impact, and iterating based on real-world performance. A strong ability to think strategically while executing tactically is essential.



Data-Driven Decision Maker
The client values a Product Manager who can turn data into actionable insights. You should be comfortable leveraging user analytics, clinical outcome data, and performance metrics to guide product direction and assess impact. Experience with A/B testing, user behavior analytics, and health outcome tracking is highly valued.



Collaborative Team Player
You’ll be working cross-functionally with clinical, technical, design, and business stakeholders. The client is looking for someone who excels in communication, stakeholder alignment, and project coordination. You should be adept at gathering diverse perspectives and translating them into cohesive, executable product plans.



Regulatory & Compliance Awareness
Experience working within healthcare compliance frameworks such as HIPAA, FDA (for software as a medical device), and other regulatory requirements is critical. The client is seeking someone who can design and manage products with data privacy, patient safety, and regulatory compliance top-of-mind.



User-Centric Mindset
A deep empathy for patients and healthcare providers is essential. You should be passionate about improving patient outcomes, reducing provider burden, and creating intuitive user experiences. The ability to conduct user research and apply findings to enhance usability is a major plus.



Excellent Communication & Presentation Skills
The client values a product leader who can clearly articulate product goals, status updates, and ROI to both technical teams and executive leadership. You should be confident in presenting strategies and delivering insights that influence stakeholders at every level.



Adaptability & Innovation
In a rapidly evolving digital health landscape, the ability to adapt to change and think creatively is essential. The client seeks someone who embraces innovation, is comfortable navigating ambiguity, and is always looking for new ways to enhance product value and market impact.



FAQs About the Role – Remote Patient Monitoring Product Manager – San Diego, CA
1. What are the key responsibilities of the Remote Patient Monitoring Product Manager?
As the Product Manager for Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM), you will be responsible for defining and executing the product strategy, managing the product lifecycle, and ensuring the product meets the needs of patients, providers, and healthcare systems. You will oversee cross-functional teams, collaborate with clinical and technical stakeholders, and drive product innovation. Additionally, you will ensure compliance with healthcare regulations, track product performance, and lead market research to inform product enhancements.



2. What qualifications and experience are required for this position?
The ideal candidate should have experience in healthcare technology or digital health product management, with a strong focus on Remote Patient Monitoring or related solutions. A background in clinical workflows, regulatory compliance (such as HIPAA), and familiarity with patient-centered technologies is highly valued. Experience in managing cross-functional teams, designing product roadmaps, and using data-driven approaches to inform decisions is essential. A degree in a related field (e.g., Healthcare Management, Computer Science, or Engineering) is preferred, and an advanced degree is a plus.



3. What leadership qualities are essential for this role?
The client is seeking a leader who can drive cross-functional collaboration, communicate a compelling product vision, and motivate teams to deliver impactful healthcare solutions. Strong problem-solving skills, adaptability, and the ability to make data-informed decisions are critical. Additionally, the Product Manager should demonstrate an empathetic, user-centered approach to designing solutions that enhance patient outcomes and provider efficiency.



4. What challenges can I expect in this role?
In this role, you will face challenges such as balancing the needs of diverse stakeholders (patients, providers, payers), navigating the regulatory landscape, and ensuring the successful adoption of RPM solutions. You will need to work within a rapidly evolving digital health market while maintaining a focus on patient safety, data privacy, and healthcare compliance. Managing product iterations and responding to user feedback while driving innovation will also be key challenges.



5. What is the expected impact of the Product Manager on the company's growth?
The Product Manager is expected to drive the adoption and success of RPM products by enhancing product functionality, improving user engagement, and ensuring clinical outcomes. By aligning product development with market demands and regulatory requirements, you will contribute to the company’s reputation as a leader in digital health innovation and help expand its market share in the RPM space.



6. What is the company’s culture and work environment like?
The company fosters a collaborative, mission-driven environment focused on improving patient care through technology. They value creativity, innovation, and teamwork in solving healthcare challenges. You will have the opportunity to work in a fast-paced, cross-functional setting while contributing to meaningful projects that make a difference in people’s lives. Flexibility and a focus on work-life balance are integral to the company’s culture.



What Remuneration Can You Expect from This Job?
As the Remote Patient Monitoring Product Manager in San Diego, CA, you can expect a competitive and comprehensive compensation package designed to attract highly skilled professionals in the digital health and healthcare technology sectors. The remuneration for this role typically includes:


1. Base Salary
The base salary for a Remote Patient Monitoring Product Manager typically ranges from $110,000 to $160,000 per year. The salary can vary based on your level of experience, the complexity of the role, and the company’s market position within the healthcare technology space.


2. Performance-Based Bonuses
In addition to the base salary, you may be eligible for annual performance-based bonuses. These bonuses are typically tied to product milestones, customer adoption rates, revenue growth, and operational success. Performance bonuses generally range from 10% to 20% of the base salary depending on individual and team performance.


3. Equity & Stock Options
As part of the total compensation package, many companies in the healthcare technology industry offer equity-based incentives, including stock options or performance shares. These incentives are designed to align your compensation with the long-term success of the company, potentially increasing your financial reward as the company grows.


4. Health & Wellness Benefits
The company provides comprehensive health benefits, which may include:




 	
Health, dental, and vision insurance



 	
Life insurance



 	
Disability coverage



 	
Wellness programs and mental health support




Additionally, there may be company-sponsored fitness memberships or wellness initiatives.


5. Retirement & Financial Planning
The company offers competitive 401(k) retirement plans with company matching contributions, as well as other financial planning services to ensure your long-term financial health and security.


6. Signing Bonuses & Relocation Assistance
For highly qualified candidates, the company may offer signing bonuses or relocation packages to facilitate a smooth transition to the role. These packages can range from $5,000 to $25,000 depending on individual circumstances and location.


7. Professional Development & Learning Opportunities
The company is committed to your continued professional growth, offering financial support for attending industry conferences, certifications, and relevant training programs, as well as opportunities to further your education.



Total Compensation Potential
When factoring in the base salary, performance bonuses, stock options, benefits, and any additional incentives, the total compensation package for a Remote Patient Monitoring Product Manager can range from $130,000 to $200,000 annually, with the potential for growth depending on company performance and your contributions.



How to Apply
If you are a passionate and experienced Product Manager with a strong background in remote patient monitoring and a drive to make a meaningful impact on healthcare delivery, we invite you to apply for the Remote Patient Monitoring Product Manager role in San Diego, CA. This is an exciting opportunity to join a cutting-edge healthcare technology company and help shape the future of patient care through innovative product development.


To apply, please submit the following:




 	
Your Resume



 	
A Cover Letter detailing your experience in remote patient monitoring, product management, and healthcare technology. Be sure to highlight your ability to lead cross-functional teams, develop customer-centric solutions, and implement strategies that drive product adoption and market success.




In your cover letter, emphasize any specific achievements that demonstrate your impact on healthcare outcomes or technological innovations in patient monitoring.


This role offers a chance to be at the forefront of transforming healthcare, with an opportunity to develop products that improve patient care and operational efficiency. Apply today to take the next step in your career as a Remote Patient Monitoring Product Manager in San Diego, CA!


For more information or to explore similar opportunities, visit our Healthcare Technology Product Management Jobs Page.

postings.title: Operations Data Analyst
postings.description: Job Title: Operations Data Analyst Job Description: Here at Entegris, we use advanced science to enable technologies that transform the world, and we are seeking employees who have the drive to continue that mission. The Role: Our site is seeking a highly skilled Data Analyst to support Entegris by partnering across R&D, Materials Quality, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Digital teams to ensure critical data is defined, structured, and transformed into usable, trusted, and sustainable datasets. As a batch chemical manufacturer serving the semiconductor industry, we require the highest standards of quality, traceability, and control. The Data Analyst in this role will play a critical part in improving data health, enabling analytics and digital solutions, and ensuring future‑state data sustainability by standardizing data definitions, collaborating with IT on improving data pipelines, and strengthening the processes and tools that generate and manage data. Entegris is a mid-sized company that values learning, growth, and professional development. This position bridges business process knowledge, continuous improvement, and analytics by translating prioritized business data needs into meaningful analysis, dashboards, insights, and governance practices that enable decision‑making, operational excellence, and digital transformation. What You’ll Do: Partner with cross‑functional teams (R&D, Materials Quality, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, CI, and Digital/IT) to understand business processes and define critical data elements, metrics, and data requirements. Translate business and operational needs into well‑defined, structured, and governed processes, resulting in reliable data sets that enable analytics, reporting, and digital solutions. Work with the IT Data team to Design, build, and maintain reliable, scalable data pipelines that transform raw data into curated, usable datasets aligned to business priorities. Improve data quality, consistency, and usability by identifying gaps, root causes, and process issues impacting data health. Drive improvements to data generation processes and tools to ensure future data is sustainable, standardized, and fit for purpose. Use Power Automate, Power Apps, and the Power Platform to streamline and unify data‑collection systems into automated, scalable workflows. Design and deliver scalable web applications using Python frameworks, ensuring intuitive user experiences and robust backend data integration. Develop data systems connected to internal platforms, APIs, and analytics pipelines to enable streamlined workflows. Establish and reinforce data standards, definitions, and documentation to enable alignment and shared understanding across teams. Collaborate with analytics, digital, and IT teams to ensure data foundations support advanced analytics, automation, and digital initiatives. Prioritize data work based on business value and critical data needs, balancing near‑term use cases with long‑term data health. Support continuous improvement efforts by enabling fact‑based problem solving through accessible, reliable data. Reinforce ownership and stewardship of data across functions to ensure improvements are embedded and sustained. What We Seek: B.S. degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline. Three to five years’ experience (or more) in data analysis, web application development, analytics or data enablement within a manufacturing, quality, or operational environment. Strong experience with SQL, data‑lake architectures, and ETL pipelines, including supporting data‑model development, debugging data‑flow issues, and managing deployment of end‑to‑end data solutions. Strong object‑oriented programming skills in Python (Django, Flask, FastAPI) for web application development. Demonstrated experience working with cross‑functional stakeholders to define data requirements and translate them into technical solutions. Strong problem‑solving and systems‑thinking skills with the ability to connect business processes to data structures and flows. Experience creating dashboards (Python, Power BI), reports, and curated datasets that support analytics and decision‑making. Strong communication skills with the ability to explain data concepts to non‑technical audiences and influence without authority. Required Experience: Experience developing web applications for data collection, including consolidating multiple data‑entry interfaces into a unified, efficient, and user‑friendly platform. Data discovery and definition (understanding source systems, data generation processes, and business context). Data analysis and transformation to create clean, usable, and scalable datasets. Improving data quality through process, tooling, and governance improvements. Partnering with business and technical teams to prioritize and deliver business processes and data solutions aligned to business needs. Outstanding Candidates Will Have: Experience supporting manufacturing, quality, R&D, or regulated environments where data accuracy and traceability are critical. Proficiency with Power Automate, Power Apps, and the Power Platform, including designing automated workflows, building custom apps, integrating connectors, and optimizing end‑to‑end data‑collection processes. Strong understanding of how process discipline and standard work enable sustainable, high‑quality data. Experience working alongside Digital, IT, or analytics teams to support dashboards, advanced analytics, or digital solutions. Familiarity with continuous improvement principles and how data enables operational excellence. Ability to coach teams on data thinking, data health, and sustainable data practices. Our total rewards package goes above and beyond just a paycheck. Whether you’re looking to build your career, improve your health, or protect your wealth, we offer generous benefits to help you achieve your goals. Compensation: $86,000.00 - $108,000.00 per year with actual pay dependent on candidate overall skills Annual bonus eligibility Progressive paid time off policy that empowers you to take the time you need to recharge Generous 401(K) plan with an impressive employer match with no delayed vesting Excellent health, dental and vision insurance packages to fit your needs Education assistance to support your learning journey A values-driven culture with colleagues that rally around People, Accountability, Creativity and Excellence Entegris does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role. Do not apply for this role if you will need Entegris immigration sponsorship (e.g., H1B, TN, STEM OPT, etc.) now or in the future. At Entegris we are committed to providing equal opportunity to all employees and applicants. Our policy is to recruit, hire, train, and reward employees for their individual abilities, achievements, and experience without regard to race, color, religion, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, marital or military status. #LI-BS1 At Entegris, we want you to be part of our culture, which values your unique talents, skills, and experiences. We believe what we do is as important as how we do it. People at our company bring their true selves to work, and are appreciated not only for what they do, but for who they are. This plus the technical complexity of our products and solutions means you can be sure your work is both challenging and changing the world for the better. Learn more about why people enjoy working at Entegris.

postings.description:
Description:As a CAM for a program directorate and one or more Work Breakdown Elements, you will be responsible for cost, schedule, and technical performance of a product(s) within the FBM portfolio. The CAM will support the Propulsion, Structures, Ordinance and Controls organization to manage scope for modernization and tooling oversight. You will have ownership of all aspects from design through delivery. The Product Owner will oversee daily tasking across a multi-functional team, including but not limited to, engineering, supply chain, contracts, finance, planning and production. This position will be CAM of record for multiple control accounts associated with that product. The candidate will work closely with: Certified Principal Engineers and responsible Project Engineers, to help resolve any technical issues; Resource Analysts to budget, track and estimate cost; Planning to schedule and status progress; Supplier Management to place, track and update non-labor deliveries. This will include leading, budgeting, and managing the cost/schedule/technical performance for multiple products, over multiple Contract Line Items over multiple contracts.

The role is challenging, but also very rewarding with significant potential for exposure on this high-visibility, fast moving and complex program with career advancement in the Program Management function. 
________________________________________


In this role will offer you the following daily key responsibilities:


• Technical, Cost and Schedule execution for selected projects(s), with a focus on meeting delivery commitment dates and budget targets and technical specifications.
Developing a baseline plan and managing overall execution of support organizations required to ensure program execution success, such as Supplier Management Operations, Engineering, Finance and Planning.
• Supporting the overall programmatic business rhythm for baseline management, monthly reporting, status and communication, and overall Earned Value Management (EVM) performance of your span of control. This can include generation of monthly VARs.
• Coordinate staffing requirements for your program scope with the program leadership team for consolidation of total program requirements.
• Reporting and briefing to the Director and/or Managers at recurring reviews within the program business rhythm.
• Resolving programmatic challenges within your scope and establishing risk mitigation activities. Demonstrated experience in driving complex issues or problems to successful closure
• Promote an environment of continuous improvement and digital transformation within your responsible program scope as well as for the Denver CAM community.
Basic Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college in a related discipline, or equivalent experience/combined education, 
• Experience working with multiple functions simultaneously to execute a program, including Program Management, Engineering, Production, Supply Chain, Planning or Finance,
• Control Account Manager (CAM) experiences, including Earned Value Management tracking, reporting and Variance Analysis writing,
• Experience managing performance metrics,
• Tableau Familiarity with ability to effectively utilize data.
• You will need to be a US Citizen, and be able to obtain and maintain a US DoD SECRET clearance, to support this government contract, as well as successfully pass a drug and background check, in order to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.
Desired Skills:
• Company Control Account Manager certification or PMI/PMP Certification 
• Direct Subcontract and/or Material management experience
• Previous Basis of Estimate (BOE) generation experience. 
• Risk and Opportunity Management development and tracking experience
• You bring positivity and enthusiasm to every project you touch. In addition to the work, you love being part of a team and working collaboratively through the process.
• Demonstrated exceptional strategic communication skills, both written, verbal, and presentation, to effectively communicate business cases to all levels of peers, suppliers, and stakeholders, as well as program executives, with an ability to persuade and motivate action.
Security Clearance Statement: This position requires a government security clearance, you must be a US Citizen for consideration.
Clearance Level: Secret
Other Important Information You Should Know
Expression of Interest: By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in this position and could be considered for other career opportunities where similar skills and requirements have been identified as a match.  Should this match be identified you may be contacted for this and future openings.
Ability to Work Remotely: Onsite Full-time: The work associated with this position will be performed onsite at a designated Lockheed Martin facility.
Work Schedules: Lockheed Martin supports a variety of alternate work schedules that provide additional flexibility to our employees.  Schedules range from standard 40 hours over a five day work week while others may be condensed.  These condensed schedules provide employees with additional time away from the office and are in addition to our Paid Time off benefits.
Schedule for this Position: 9x80 every other Friday off
Pay Rate: The annual base salary range for this position in California, Massachusetts, and New York (excluding most major metropolitan areas), Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Minnesota, New Jersey, Vermont, Washington or Washington DC is $85,500  - $150,765. For states not referenced above, the salary range for this position will reflect the candidate’s final work location. Please note that the salary information is a general guideline only. Lockheed Martin considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/ training, key skills as well as market and business considerations when extending an offer.
Benefits offered: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, Long-Term Disability, 401(k) match, Flexible Spending Accounts, EAP, Education Assistance, Parental Leave, Paid time off, and Holidays. 
(Washington state applicants only) Non-represented full-time employees: accrue at least 10 hours per month of Paid Time Off (PTO) to be used for incidental absences and other reasons; receive at least 90 hours for holidays. Represented full time employees accrue 6.67 hours of Vacation per month; accrue up to 52 hours of sick leave annually; receive at least 96 hours for holidays. PTO, Vacation, sick leave, and holiday hours are prorated based on start date during the calendar year.
This position is incentive plan eligible.
Lockheed Martin is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified candidates will be considered without regard to legally protected characteristics.
The application window will close in 90 days; applicants are encouraged to apply within 5 - 30 days of the requisition posting date in order to receive optimal consideration.

Our flexible schedules, competitive pay, and comprehensive benefits enable our employees to live a healthy, fulfilling life at and outside of work. We place an emphasis on empowering our employees by fostering an inclusive environment built upon integrity and corporate responsibility.

postings.title: Senior Analytics Engineer Consultant
postings.description:
Introduction

 At IBM, our work is more than just a job—it's a mission to innovate, design, and solve today's toughest challenges. Are you ready to lead in this technological revolution and tackle critical global issues? If you are, we want to hear from you!

 Your Role and Responsibilities

 We are seeking a Senior Analytics Engineer Consultant to join our dynamic team of professionals. In this pivotal role, you will bridge the gap between data engineering and analytics, turning raw data into reliable, well-structured, and comprehensively documented assets. These assets will empower decision-making, business intelligence, and supporting AI/ML applications.

 In this role, you will:

  Design and deliver analytical data models, semantic layers, and testing frameworks. Collaborate with Data Engineers, BI Developers, Analysts, and clients to translate business needs into effective data solutions. Lead modeling decisions on client engagements and mentor junior analytics engineers and analysts. Apply software engineering principles to analytics, including modular SQL, automated testing, and data model management.  The ideal candidate will embrace the challenges of software engineering within analytics, recognize data models as products, and drive accountability for their performance.

 This position is remote and can be performed from anywhere within the U.S.

 Required Technical and Professional Expertise

  Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, analytics, statistics, or equivalent practical experience. 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data modeling, or related fields, delivering production analytics on cloud platforms. Expert-level SQL skills for complex queries, including optimization techniques (Snowflake preferred, but Databricks, BigQuery, or Redshift are acceptable). Experience managing dbt projects, including advanced features such as incremental models and snapshots. Strong understanding of dimensional modeling methodologies and their practical applications. Ability to translate business requirements into robust modeling architectures. Experience defining metrics in a semantic layer and ensuring consistency across BI tools. Proficiency in implementing data quality frameworks and testing protocols. Familiarity with Git workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and orchestration tools. Some experience with Python for data automation and transformations. Cloud experience on AWS required (familiarity with Azure or GCP is a plus). Strong ability to integrate with BI tools and foster alignment with BI developers. Proven capability to mentor junior team members and lead engagements effectively. Excellent interpersonal and problem-solving skills, coupled with an action-oriented mindset. Comfortable working within Agile teams. Experience in hiring and managing technical staff.  Preferred Technical and Professional Experience

  Relevant certifications in Snowflake or dbt are highly desirable. Experience with reverse-ETL tools and operational analytics. Expertise in governance of metrics and semantic layers at scale. Familiarity with data cataloging and observability tools. Background in supporting AI/ML initiatives with well-curated data. Understanding of data contracts and analytics models as consumer-oriented products. Experience in industries such as financial services, healthcare, retail, or public sector is a plus.  IBM is dedicated to fostering a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to various characteristics such as race, gender, age, or disability. IBM also adheres to fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status.

postings.title: Machine Learning Engineer II - AV Foundation, AV Labs
postings.description:
About the Role


Uber is launching AV Labs to accelerate the autonomous technology ecosystem. We’re building out a high-velocity team of multi-disciplinary experts to turn real-world operations into high-quality data for our autonomous partners. This team will be focused on the hardest problem in AV today: unlocking real-world, long-tail driving data. Autonomy is now a data race–and Uber has an edge: We collect rare, real-world driving data at a scale and capital efficiency no one else can match (millions of Uber trips every hour across cities, conditions, and edge cases create the data autonomy has been missing). We will build platforms that harness scale and real-world complexity to reimagine how the world moves.


You will be an ML engineer in AV Labs conducting autonomous vehicle modeling and research, with an emphasis on developing foundational and applied techniques that shape the future of autonomous driving. The ideal candidate will formulate research problems, design and evaluate novel modeling approaches, and influence the direction of large-scale autonomous systems through strong scientific judgment and execution. You will work cross-functionally with engineers from AV Labs and partner engineering teams which enables Uber’s mission of helping people go anywhere and get anything and earn their way.


What You Will Do:



Design and implement cutting-edge techniques for autonomous vehicle systems.
Collaborate closely with engineering teams and product teams across AV Labs to integrate modeling approaches into production pipelines.
Publish and present original research at top-tier CV and ML conferences.

Basic Qualifications:



PhD or MS with equivalent industry experience in Computer Science, Robotics, or a related field.
Relevant experience in autonomous vehicles or computer vision, with a strong understanding of how research ideas connect to autonomous vehicle systems.
Demonstrated technical contributions, including publications at leading ML and CV conferences such as CVPR, ICCV, ICLR, NeurIPS, or similar venues.
Proficiency in Python and modern deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow; experience with C++ or deploying models in production environments is a plus.
Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with researchers and engineers across teams.

Preferred Qualifications:



Experience with autonomous vehicles research.
Hands-on experience in training multimodal LLMs for autonomous vehicle systems or relevant computer vision systems.
Recent publications in one or more of the following areas: 3D perception & scene understanding, multimodal embedding, diffusion models, gaussian splatting, vision language action models, and world models.
Experience with real-world product development and deployment.

For Sunnyvale, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD$171,000 per year - USD$190,000 per year.


You will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits. More details can be found at the following link https://jobs.uber.com/en/benefits.


Uber's mission is to reimagine the way the world moves for the better. Here, bold ideas create real-world impact, challenges drive growth, and speed fuels progress. What moves us, moves the world - let's move it forward, together.


Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.


Offices continue to be central to collaboration and Uber's cultural identity. Unless formally approved to work fully remotely, Uber expects employees to spend at least half of their work time in their assigned office. For certain roles, such as those based at green-light hubs, employees are expected to be in-office for 100% of their time. Please speak with your recruiter to better understand in-office expectations for this role.

postings.title: UX Researcher & Designer
postings.description:
Are you a UX Designer with 5+ years of experience, and a strong portfolio demonstrating experience designing for B2B SaaS applications? Do you obsess over understanding users, their needs, and their goals? Are you constantly thinking about the most intuitive workflows and designs? Do you thrive on solving complex problems with the simplest solutions?

If so, Grant Street Group may be the perfect fit for you. As a software company specializing in government products, we believe design is a key part in creating effective, efficient, and taxpayer friendly solutions.

We’re looking for someone to join our UX department and partner with our Business Analysts, Product Managers, and Sales and Marketing teams to create intuitive, scalable, and user-friendly interfaces that drive engagement and efficiency of complex applications.

**What will you have the opportunity to do in this position?**

*   Plan and execute user research studies such as contextual inquiries, user surveys, and usability tests.
*   Analyze user requirements and business needs through use cases, user research, and user flows.
*   Create design concepts, information architecture, wireframes, detailed user interface designs, interactive prototypes, and user interface specifications for various applications.
*   Work closely with the development and testing teams in the implementation and testing of user interfaces.
*   Create and maintain user experience guidelines and design standards.

**Some of the projects we’ve focused on recently include:**

Researching, prototyping, and designing a brand new Taxing Entity Portal, which combines several laborious processes into one sleek portal, saving time, and reducing frustration between our Tax Collector clients and the Taxing Districts they collect taxes for.

![Image 1](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/682daf71a326c3b4d64c0cba/69b4630fdd8ec9189005a631_Picture1.jpg)

Testing our applications for accessibility and ADA compliance, and working with our product development teams to ensure that all of our clients’ customers can use our sites seamlessly.

![Image 2](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/682daf71a326c3b4d64c0cba/69b463386f3d928c1b562d6f_Picture3.jpg)

**Here are a few of the specific things we are looking for:**

*   Experience:
    *   Identifying UX issues.
    *   Using UI/UX design best practices.
    *   Planning & conducting user research (in Userlytics, Lyssna, etc.).
    *   Making informed design decisions using qualitative and quantitative data.
    *   Using Figma, Sketch, or Adobe XD for creating high-fidelity mockups.
    *   Ensuring designs align with overall business goals, meeting the needs of both users and stakeholders.
    *   Iterating on design concepts using rapid prototyping, incorporating feedback from product managers and stakeholders.

*   Solid understanding of:
    *   Mobile-first and responsive design.
    *   WCAG accessibility guidelines.
    *   HTML and CSS.

*   Strong commitment to owning your projects and seeing them through to successful completion.
*   A knack for solving complex problems, simply.
*   Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
    *   Tailoring your communication to diverse audiences (clients, stakeholders, product leads, developers, etc).
    *   Clearly & concisely articulating design decisions, the rationale behind those decisions, and how it aligns with or supports client/company/product goals.

*   Hunger and ability to learn complex tools/technologies.
*   Willingness to travel on occasion (around 5%).

If you have all of these traits, or if you’re looking for somewhere to learn and develop them, we can’t wait to review your application.

Keep in mind that we have a tendency to pay special attention to those that put in extra effort in their applications. We are proponents of the belief that you are more than just a resume, so if you have experience designing other websites, applications, marketing pieces, artwork, etc., share them with us! Simply include links or images with your resume.

Excited to join us? We’re excited to have you! Apply today and we’ll get the ball rolling.

postings.title: Senior Software Engineer
postings.description:
Summary


 The Senior Software Engineer will participate in the architecture, design, development, test and integration of software features for, or in support of, RAVE In-flight Entertainment (IFE).


 


 

   Core Responsibilities


 
  Contribute to the design, creation, development and improvement of software features, packaging, tools, testing, test automation, continuous integration, delivery, and documentation
  Build and maintain automated tests (unit, integration, system-level)
  Triage, debug, and resolve issues
  Take ownership of quality and drive continuous improvement
  Provide accurate estimates and deliver on commitments with transparency
  Collaborate with stakeholders, users, and teams on design, implementation, and approvals
  Engage actively in meetings and technical discussions
  Coordinate with internal teams to support product success
  Prepare and present technical concepts clearly and effectively
  Follow and help improve SDLC and organizational processes
  Provide guidance, mentoring, and training within the software team, while offering support across the broader product development organization
 
 
 Requirements
 

   Core Qualifications


 
  Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent experience in a related field
  6+ years of software development experience with one or more of the following:
  Software development in C/C++ on Linux/UNIX, embedded, or Windows (.NET, C#, JavaScript, SQL)
  Modern tech stack: Qt/QML, Node.js, Golang, React, Typescript, Python, PostgreSQL, Docker, MQTT, Microservices
  Experiences with any of the following languages, technologies and techniques would be advantageous:
  IPC, RPC, sockets, A/V players
  Networking & protocols: Ethernet, ARINC 429, RS-485, I2C, SPI, MDIO, CAN
  Experience with npm, Bower or Webpack
  Debugging & troubleshooting
 
 
 Benefits
 

   In addition to a comprehensive package of health benefits that include company contributions, RAVE Aerospace offers a variety of additional benefits and perks to enhance your work-life balance experience including but not limited to:


 
  A home allowance to elevate your home workspace
  Discretionary bonus program
  Future financial security with a 401(k) program with company match
  Paid time off covering vacations, personal time off and sick days, capped off by an exciting year-end holiday shutdown
  Embraced flexibility with our alternative work schedule (9/80) to navigate your workweeks with every other Friday off

Strong leadership skills and a desire to provide guidance to junior team members

postings.title: Computer Vision/Machine Learning Engineer
postings.description:
About the Role
We are looking for a Computer Vision / Machine Learning Engineer to join a fast-growing, product-driven team working on real-world AI applications.


This role focuses on building and optimizing lightweight visual models for production environments, with strong emphasis on performance, efficiency, and deployment.


 What You'll Do


Model Selection

Choose the most suitable approaches (traditional algorithms vs. deep learning) based on real-world use cases and constraints


Performance Optimization

Optimize models by balancing accuracy, latency, memory, and power consumption


Model Training & Compression

Train and optimize lightweight models using techniques such as quantization, pruning, and knowledge distillation


Deployment & Optimization

Deploy models to production environments (mobile/edge), ensuring low latency and high efficiency


End-to-End Ownership

Drive the full lifecycle from data analysis  model development  optimization  deployment


Application Performance

Improve overall application responsiveness and resource usage to ensure smooth user experience


 Requirements
 Education


Bachelor's degree with 3+ years of experience, OR


Master's degree with 1+ year of experience, OR


PhD in a related field


 Technical Skills


Strong foundation in Computer Vision and Machine Learning


Experience with model optimization for production (latency, memory, power trade-offs)


Hands-on experience with lightweight model deployment (e.g., ONNX, TFLite, CoreML)


Experience with model compression techniques (quantization, pruning, distillation)


Solid programming skills (Python + ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow)


 Experience


Experience building and deploying models in real-world production environments


Familiar with edge/mobile AI scenarios or performance-constrained systems


 Soft Skills


Strong problem-solving ability and ownership mindset


Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment


Able to independently drive projects end-to-end


 Nice to Have


Experience with mobile/edge deployment (iOS / Android)


Experience optimizing models for real-time applications


Background in performance-critical systems

postings.title: Cloud Engineer- Secret Clearance required
postings.description:
Description: 
  Security Clearance: Active Secret clearance required (Interim ok)


  Travel Requirement: Up to 10%


  Citizenship: US Citizenship required


 At Sherpa 6, we build innovative software solutions for forward-leaning customers who operate in demanding, high-impact environments. We are seeking a visionary Cloud Engineer to lead the design, evolution, and optimization of our cloud-deployed systems. This role will own the architecture for our flagship products, shaping scalable, secure, and resilient cloud solutions from the ground up. The ideal candidate will not only architect world-class systems, but also establish best practices, mature our cloud processes, and drive efficiency and cost-effectiveness as we continue to grow and scale our development organization.


  Responsibilities:


 
  Work closely with the software development teams to design and implement systems using Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
  Focus on developing processes and practices that emphasize scalability and re-usability as we deploy multiple instances of our software
  Act as the subject matter expert of cloud management and lead our team towards industry best practices
  Take ownership of our existing infrastructure and work to improve its efficiency and quality
  Work in tandem with our engineering team to identify and implement the most optimal cloud-based solutions
  Define and document best practices and strategies regarding application deployment and infrastructure maintenance
  Participate in all aspects of the software development lifecycle for cloud solutions, including planning, requirements, development, testing, and quality assurance
  Troubleshoot incidents, identify root causes, fix and document problems, and implement preventive measures
  Requirements: 
 
  Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  5+ years of experience in Cloud Engineering
  Azure Fundamentals Certificate
  Security+ Certification
  Experience with public cloud architecture, cloud strategy, networking, security, compliance workload types, migration patterns, tools, and PKI
  Experience with various enterprise applications and IT services, as well as software development, compliance and security, and IT operations disciplines.
  Knowledge of cloud design patterns, cloud operations and cloud cost models with experience implementing best practices or suggested improvements.
  Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen attention to detail.
  Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams
 
  Qualities of Exceptional Candidates:


 
  Azure Administrator Associate
  Azure Network Engineer Associate
 
  About Sherpa 6:


 At Sherpa 6 we love to solve problems and provide the best solutions for our customers. Our approach to a problem is to find a user-focused and design-driven solution that is simple yet functional and effective. We are a group of enthusiastic forward-thinkers who are excited to build amazing solutions with bleeding-edge technology. We hire people who are forward thinkers, passionate about what they do, love to collaborate and want to constantly learn. We enjoy what we do and we're not afraid to put the extra effort in to accomplish the mission; call us Sherpas. As a Service-Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business, we know what it means to serve. We have made it our mission to be the leaders in solutions that protect and give our Warfighters the edge they need when put into harm's way.


  Background Screening/Check/Investigation:


 Successful completion of a background screening/check/investigation will/may be required as a condition of hire.


  ADA:


 Sherpa 6 will make reasonable accommodations in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act 1990.


  EEO/AA:


 Sherpa 6 does not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, sex, religion age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, height, weight, or marital status in employment or the provision of services and is an equal access/opportunity/affirmative action employer.


  Benefits:


 We offer a competitive benefits package, covering the cost of medical for you and your family; we also offer dental, vision, health and wellness benefits and a generous retirement savings plan. We believe that our employees can manage their workload and their personal life, therefore we extend a generous PTO policy. This allows our employees to balance their lives as they see fit.


  Salary Range:


 The proposed salary range is reflective across all Sherpa 6 locations, years of experience, and skill levels. Salary negotiations will be based on a host of factors including but not limited to your geographic location, prior experience, relevant skills, education, and certifications.

postings.title: Corporate Project Manager II
postings.description:
About The Role
 
  

    Summary
 
 
  As part of the Enterprise Project Management Office (EPMO), this position is a strategic partner that collaborates with business owners to deliver value for customers and employees by facilitating consistent delivery of projects. Builds and continuously develops relationships with bank users, all levels of management, and vendors to increase the operational capability of the EPMO to deliver our offered services. This position is considered a representative of the EPMO to all levels of bank groups and management, and professionalism and diplomacy to gain trust is critical to the success of the position. The Project Manager II role is responsible for managing all aspects of medium to large size projects according to strict deadlines and within budget within the organization. Provides leadership while coordinating the efforts of team members and third-party contractors in order to deliver projects according to plan. Adheres to the methodologies and best practices as set forth by the EPMO through all phases of project initiation, planning, execution, and closure. Performs in a highly visible bank-facing role by owning the scope, budget, and schedule of assigned project efforts. Guides the sponsor and teams to make decisions, however, is not the decision maker. Utilizes exceptional communication skills to effectively lead cross-functional, virtual teams while interfacing with senior management and all levels of the organization.
 
 
 
  

    This is a Corporate position which may be located at an available bank division location across our nine-state footprint in AZ, CO, ID, MT, NV, TX, UT, WA, or WY. The entry pay for this position is $81,764.23 + / per year (calculated for Kalispell, MT). Click here to learn more about our bank divisions.
 
 
 
  

    All compensation offers are analyzed individually and take into consideration multiple factors including but not limited to geographic location, years of experience, and educational background.
 
 
 
  

    WA Applicants ONLY range: $89,059.78 to $133,589.68 a year.
 
 
 
  

    Job Duties
 
 
  Project Execution: Applies project management methodologies and control techniques throughout the project lifecycle. Executes plans and coordinates with team members to complete the project according to scope, on time, and within budget. Provide steady leadership in the face of uncertainty, change, and aggressive deadlines. Lead cross-functional meetings and foster teamwork. Act as an advisor and build/maintain relationships across the stakeholder community. Partner with the executive sponsor to communicate project goals, objectives and potential outcomes. Lead regular interactions with the executive sponsor to inform, alert, negotiate, and maintain a continuing good relationship and shared vision for the project outcome. Effectively negotiates with project stakeholders and team members to drive project delivery to a successful completion. Communicates with project team members regularly through team meetings, documented minutes, and weekly status reports. Manages and updates changes to project documentation, such as, the budget, schedule, and decision log. Identifies and manages project risks and issues and works with impacted areas to reach a resolution. Follows procedures for scope changes if required. Guides stakeholders through system selection processes such as requirements definition, Requests for Information (RFI), Requests for Proposal (RFP), demos, reference checks, vendor due diligence, and solution evaluation. Documents all project decisions during the vendor selection process.
  Project Planning: Applies a rigorous project management planning discipline following the project management procedures. Develops and maintains detailed project plans (scope, requirements, success criteria, and dependencies), budgets, and schedules for projects in collaboration with project sponsors and stakeholders. Identifies and requests needed resources and estimates their work efforts. Identifies, evaluates, and manages project risks and prepares contingency plans. Obtains project sponsor signoff on planning documentation where required.
  Project Closure: Finalizes project schedule, budget, and documentation, and makes certain all requirements are met. Effectively handles the transition from project to daily operation with the functional areas and obtains project sponsor sign off. Documents lessons learned for inclusion with post implementation review.
  Governance: Adheres to and supports the use of governance, security and risk management practices.
  Must comply with all company policies and procedures and all applicable laws and regulations, including but not limited to, the Bank Secrecy Act, the Patriot Act, and the Office of Foreign Assets Control. Must complete the assigned online training courses and achieve a passing score by due date.

In-depth dialogues, conversations and explanations with customers, direct and indirect reports and outside vendors can be of a sensitive and/or highly confidential nature. Communications may involve motivating, influencing, educating and/or advising others on matters of significance.

We offer an extensive benefits package that includes, but is not limited to medical, dental, vision, and life insurance. Coverage is available to employees and their eligible dependents in accordance with our written plan documents. postings.description:
Business Intelligence Analyst (AECO)Location: Westminster, CO (In-Person)

Sector: Architecture, Engineering, Construction & Owner (AECO)

The OpportunityAre you a data-driven problem solver who thrives on turning complex datasets into competitive advantages? Trimble is looking for a Business Intelligence Analyst to join our Platform team. You will be the technical backbone of our growth strategy, analyzing the intersection of global infrastructure trends and SaaS performance to identify exactly where and how we should expand.

What Makes This Role GreatThis isn't just about building dashboards; it’s about discovery. You will leverage modern AI tools and predictive analytics to move beyond traditional reporting, helping to build the "Strategic Growth Engines" that transform how the world builds and operates. You will have direct exposure to senior leaders, providing the data-backed evidence they need to make high-stakes capital allocation decisions.

What You Will DoData Mining & Interpretation: Analyze complex business problems using internal SaaS metrics and external market data to provide actionable insights for decision-makers.

Trend & Pattern Analysis: Identify and interpret trends within AECO datasets to locate market influences, regional shifts, and product-led growth opportunities.

Strategic Forecasting: Construct data-driven forecasts and tactical plans based on deep market knowledge and business data to support the Platform division.  Drive the monthly and quarterly forecasting process for the Platform division, translating SaaS metrics (ARR, Churn, Retention) into predictable financial outcomes. 

Variance & Performance Analysis: Conduct deep-dive variance analysis of actuals versus budget, identifying the "why" behind the numbers and providing actionable insights to senior leaders to optimize capital allocation. 

Business Advisory: Serve as a trusted financial advisor to International Public Sector leaders, providing budgetary guidance and cost-benefit analyses for new product-led growth initiatives. 

Technical Specifications: Create detailed specifications for reports and custom analyses based on evolving business needs and available data elements.

AI & Automation: Experiment with modern data tools (predictive analytics, anomaly detection) to automate manual reporting and improve the accuracy of our global growth models.

Collaborative Consulting: Directly produce datasets and reports for cross-functional teams, serving as a technical consultant to help users interpret data and address business bottlenecks.

What Skills & Experience You Should BringThe Experience: 3-5+ years of experience in a relevant Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, or Finance role. Experience in a high-growth SaaS or tech environment is preferred.

Technical Mastery: Strong proficiency in SQL and data visualization tools such as Domo, Tableau, or Power BI. You should be comfortable building and maintaining your own data pipelines and dashboards.

Analytical Mindset: A self-starter mentality with the ability to focus on granular data details while understanding how they impact the "Big Picture" of global infrastructure.

Problem Solving: Proven ability to take a broad business question and translate it into a technical data query that yields a clear answer.

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Finance, Computer Science, or a related field.

postings.title: Data Scientist, Learning Supports
postings.description:
AIR is seeking a
Data Scientist
to join the
Learning Supports
program and provide foundational and advanced analytic support across multiple project teams.


The Data
Scientist will take ownership of end-to-end quantitative workflows—setting up and maintaining reproducible analytic environments, managing and quality-checking complex datasets, reviewing and strengthening junior analysts’ code, and leading inferential modeling tasks spanning both causal (e.g., experimental and quasi-experimental designs) and non-causal (e.g., descriptive, predictive, and explanatory) analyses. The role will also help expand AIR’s capacity to responsibly apply machine learning methods in support of causal and non-causal work, while translating technical results into clear, decision-relevant products for clients and stakeholders.
The Data Scientist will join AIR’s Learning Supports program, which conducts research, evaluation, and implementation support for federal and state agencies, school districts, and foundations. The program produces rigorous evidence and practical tools to inform policy and practice, helping ensure early and equitable access to learning and the supports children and families need to succeed.


This position has the flexibility to work remotely within the United States (U.S.) or from one of AIR’s U.S. office locations. This does not include U.S. territories.


About AIR
Founded in 1946 and headquartered in Arlington, Virginia, the American Institutes for Research (AIR) is a nonpartisan, not-for-profit organization that conducts behavioral and social science research and delivers technical assistance to address some of the most pressing challenges in the United States and globally. We generate evidence and apply data-driven solutions that expand opportunities and improve lives for all.


Responsibilities

Lead or contribute to the design and execution of rigorous quantitative research and evaluation projects across multiple Learning Supports initiatives.
Apply appropriate quantitative methods to collect, manage, analyze, and interpret data, including leading inferential analyses for both causal and non‑causal research questions.
Develop, maintain, and document reproducible and collaborative analytic workflows, including data management processes and quality control procedures.
Review, quality‑check, and strengthen analytic code and outputs produced by junior staff; provide guidance and mentorship to promote best practices in analysis and documentation.
Translate complex analytic findings into clear, actionable insights for client reports, technical memos, presentations, and briefings.
Manage discrete project tasks or analytic components, including planning timelines, tracking deliverables, and coordinating with project leadership and clients.
Support proposal development by contributing to technical and analytic sections and helping shape study design and analytic approaches.
Engage with internal and external stakeholders through meetings and dissemination activities, contributing to a collaborative and inclusive team environment.

Qualifications
Education, Knowledge, and Experience 
A Master’s degree with 4 years of relevant quantitative research experience or a Bachelor’s Degree with 5 years of relevant experience.
Demonstrated experience supporting or leading quantitative research or evaluation projects, preferably for public-sector, nonprofit, or education-focused clients.
Experience designing and executing inferential analyses and contributing to research reports, briefs, or presentations.
Experience managing and maintaining analytic datasets, including documentation, quality control, and reproducible workflows.
Experience with machine learning methods or interest in applying ML to support causal and non-causal research preferred, but not required.
Experience working in education or K–12 research contexts is preferred, but not required.

Skills

Proficiency in R, Stata, or Python for applied quantitative analysis.
Ability to review, quality-check, and improve others’ analytic code and support junior staff through guidance and mentorship.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to accuracy and research best practices.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate complex analyses for technical and non-technical audiences.
Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines independently while contributing to a collaborative team environment.

Disclosures:
Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the U.S. on a full-time basis. Employment-based visa sponsorship (including H-1B sponsorship) is not available for this po

Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.


The Toast POS app is the central pillar of Toast’s restaurant products. Every day, hundreds of thousands of servers, hosts, bartenders, and chefs use Toast’s POS to serve millions of guests. Our POS product is constantly evolving, and the POS Productivity team builds the platform that makes this evolution possible.


Our mission is to make it as easy as possible for 150+ Android engineers to develop new features and deliver them with high confidence and quality. We are customer-obsessed—our customers are our fellow developers, and luckily for us, they are just a Slack message away! We strive to make it easy for people to do the right thing by default.
